instanceEdit.mcpDesc: Manage this instance's MCP servers: every entry is one {'@'}deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client loader row, and its tools register as mcp__<name>__*. The scope picks the target file — global writes <HOME>/cordis.patch.yml, a profile writes <HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml; a save rewrites only the MCP rows and keeps every other entry as it is. Changes apply the next time the instance starts.

instanceEdit.mcpServerNameHint: Drives the tool prefix mcp__<name>__*, at most 32 characters

instanceEdit.mcpCwdPlaceholder: Empty inherits the launcher's working directory

instanceEdit.pluginsDesc: Manage plugins in the selected profile of this instance: enable / disable, with multi-select batch actions. Core deepseek-ai official plugins are hidden. Plugins are mounted at instance startup, so restart the instance after adding, removing, enabling or disabling one; when uninstalling, remove plugins before engine-level dependencies.
